variants.statement: When the proportional split leaves leftover cents, give one extra cent to each part with the largest fractional remainder (fraction = total_cents*weight mod sum_of_weights), breaking ties by lower index, until no cents are left.
When the proportional split leaves leftover cents, give one extra cent to parts in index order starting at index 0, until no cents are left.
variants.phrase: parts in index order starting at index 0

variants.statement: When the proportional split leaves leftover cents, do not distribute them: each part gets only its floor share and the result may sum to less than the total.
